name: API.Bible
signup: Account, app approval, and API key
free_tier: Starter: $0; open-access Bibles plus up to 3 selected copyrighted Bibles; non-commercial
premium_cost: Pro from US$29/month; commercial per-translation licences publicly start around US$10/month
premium_required_when: Any monetised use or licensed copyrighted edition required for commercial use
caveats: 500 consecutive verses/request
free tier forbids ads, subscriptions, freemium and in-app purchases
copyrighted content cannot train generative AI/LLMs without written consent
cached content must be refreshed at least every 30 days
commercial NIV is unavailable through its published plan

name: ESV API
premium_cost: No public API price; contact Crossway for expanded commercial licensing
caveats: 500 verses/query, cache, and display maximum
5,000/day; 1,000/hour; 60/minute
copyright notice and ESV.org link required
text cannot be modified
Crossway can revoke access

name: NLT API
caveats: 500 verses/request and 5,000 requests/day documented for authenticated access
copyright quotation limits still apply

name: NET Bible API
premium_cost: No published tier; commercial rights require permission
premium_required_when: Commercial publication or product use beyond copyright terms
caveats: Underlying NET text is copyrighted
passage lookup only; no documented rate limit
follow NET copyright terms

name: Bible Brain
premium_required_when: Commercial, restricted-content, or special licensing needs
caveats: end users must receive content free by default
no proxy distribution network
offline download is not generally permitted
translation-specific upstream terms and faith guidelines apply

name: Digital Bible Library
signup: DBL account; organisation Account Manager generates an organisation-scoped DBL API key
premium_cost: No public standard price; rights-holder agreements vary
premium_required_when: Controlled/copyrighted source content or organisation workflows
caveats: licensing and content-management platform, not merely a passage API
a DBL key proves the permissions of its organisation; it does not grant blanket access to the DBL catalogue
open-access content is available to DBL members under its published terms; controlled content requires an active, rights-holder-approved agreement
adding the DBL key to an API.Bible app exposes only DBL content items that the DBL organisation is permitted to use
DBL key is a credential: do not expose it in a client app, repository, or chat

name: Bible Gateway API
caveats: technical access-token documentation exists
do not rely on web scraping
confirm authorisation and rights in writing

name: Free Use Bible API
free_tier: No key or stated usage limits
caveats: retain and inspect the metadata/licence for each edition
provider claims commercial and modification freedom; verify provenance for high-risk production decisions

name: DailyBible API
caveats: small catalogue; not a broad licensed-translation provider
be respectful with request volume

name: YouVersion Platform
signup: Developer account, registered app, and App Key
free_tier: Platform describes its Bible tools as free; actual Bible collection follows accepted licence agreements
premium_required_when: No public paid tier documented; publisher/version-specific licence agreements may be required
caveats: Send X-YVP-App-Key with every request
Bible collection is limited to versions available after relevant licence agreements are accepted
do not create a competing/replicating service
AI output to users requires prior written approval; do not train, develop, refine, or improve AI using the tools
keep credentials confidential and enable built-in usage reporting
